description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's work tree status reporting, including conflict scenarios and various merge states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with the expected output.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files and messages.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test time, used for timestamping commits.
